firstPlayerRule: The player most recently swayed by one of the seven deadly sins goes first.
clarifications: Turns proceed counterclockwise. The advanced Penitenziagite mode uses the same first-player determination.

sources.title: 7: The Sins — GateOnGames English rulebook, version 1

internalEvidence: The publisher's rulebook download page links this English PDF. Rendered printed page 5 selects the player most recently swayed by one of the seven deadly sins and confirms counterclockwise order. Printed page 9 says the advanced mode begins after determining the first player, so it does not replace the initial criterion.
